mechanism_claims.claim_text: Capidermicin is source-supported as a purified 5,464 Da antimicrobial bacteriocin whose ORF4/gene-cluster context is consistent with a class II leaderless, aureocin-like bacteriocin.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Primary-source stability assays report retained antimicrobial activity across broad temperature and pH ranges, with reduced activity after trypsin or proteinase K treatment.

direct_assay_types: agar well diffusion after temperature/pH/protease treatment

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper proposes possible membrane permeabilization by analogy to lacticin Q/aureocin A53 and structural similarity; this remains inferred/hypothesis-level for capidermicin.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No direct capidermicin membrane permeabilization, leakage, pore, membrane potential, or macromolecular synthesis assay is reported locally.
